passages.text: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!
passages.sermon:
God speaks to all people who are thirsty.
God calls them to come to the waters.
God invites those who have no money.
God tells them to come, buy, and eat.
God says they can buy wine and milk.
God says they do not need money.
God says they do not need to pay any price.
passages.original: ה֤וֹי כָּל־ צָמֵא֙ לְכ֣וּ לַמַּ֔יִם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ ל֖וֹ כָּ֑סֶף לְכ֤וּ שִׁבְרוּ֙ וֶֽאֱכֹ֔לוּ וּלְכ֣וּ שִׁבְר֗וּ בְּלוֹא־ כֶ֛סֶף וּבְל֥וֹא מְחִ֖יר יַ֥יִן וְחָלָֽב׃

passages.text: Why spend money on that which is not bread, and your labor on that which does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of foods.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God asks a question.
Why do you spend your money on things that are not bread?
Why do you work hard for things that do not satisfy you?
God gives a command.
Listen carefully to Me.
Eat what is good.
Your soul will enjoy the richest food.
passages.original: לָ֤מָּה תִשְׁקְלוּ־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ בְּֽלוֹא־ לֶ֔חֶם וִיגִיעֲכֶ֖ם בְּל֣וֹא לְשָׂבְעָ֑ה שִׁמְע֨וּ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ אֵלַי֙ וְאִכְלוּ־ ט֔וֹב וְתִתְעַנַּ֥ג בַּדֶּ֖שֶׁן נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people.
God invites everyone to listen to Him.
God says, “Turn your ear to Me.
Come to Me.
Listen to Me.
If you listen, your soul will live.
I will make a covenant with you that lasts forever.
This covenant is My faithful love.
I promised this love to David.”
passages.original: הַטּ֤וּ אָזְנְכֶם֙ וּלְכ֣וּ אֵלַ֔י שִׁמְע֖וּ וּתְחִ֣י נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְאֶכְרְתָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם חַֽסְדֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הַנֶּאֱמָנִֽים׃

passages.text: Behold, I have made him a witness to the nations, a leader and commander of the peoples.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says, “I have made him a witness to the nations.”
God says, “I have made him a leader of the peoples.”
God says, “I have made him a commander of the peoples.”
passages.original: הֵ֛ן עֵ֥ד לְאוּמִּ֖ים נְתַתִּ֑יו נָגִ֥יד וּמְצַוֵּ֖ה לְאֻמִּֽים׃

passages.text: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The Holy One of Israel has given you glory.
You will call a nation you do not know.
Nations that do not know you will run to you.
They will come because the LORD your God has honored you.
They will come because the Holy One of Israel has given you glory.
passages.original: הֵ֣ן גּ֤וֹי לֹֽא־ תֵדַע֙ תִּקְרָ֔א וְג֥וֹי לֹֽא־ יְדָע֖וּךָ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יָר֑וּצוּ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְלִקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֥י פֵאֲרָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is near now.
You can find Him now.
Seek the LORD now.
Call on Him now.
He is close to you now.
passages.original: דִּרְשׁ֥וּ יְהוָ֖ה בְּהִמָּצְא֑וֹ קְרָאֻ֖הוּ בִּֽהְיוֹת֥וֹ קָרֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Let the wicked man forsake his own way and the unrighteous man his own thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
passages.sermon:
A wicked person must leave his own way.
An unrighteous person must give up his own thoughts.
He must return to the LORD.
The LORD will show him compassion.
He must return to our God.
God will freely forgive.
passages.original: יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־ יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

passages.text: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is holy and all-powerful.
The LORD says, “My thoughts are not your thoughts.
Your thoughts are not like Mine.
Your ways are not like My ways.
My ways are not your ways.”
passages.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א מַחְשְׁבוֹתַי֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם דְּרָכָ֑י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is holy and perfect.
The LORD says His ways are not like human ways.
The LORD says His thoughts are not like human thoughts.
The heavens are very high above the earth.
The LORD’s ways are much higher than human ways.
The LORD’s thoughts are much higher than human thoughts.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ גָבְה֥וּ שָׁמַ֖יִם מֵאָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֣ן גָּבְה֤וּ דְרָכַי֙ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֔ם וּמַחְשְׁבֹתַ֖י מִמַּחְשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat, so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
Rain falls from heaven.
Snow falls from heaven.
Rain and snow do not return to heaven immediately.
Rain and snow water the earth.
Rain and snow make the earth give birth to plants.
Rain and snow make the earth produce growth.
Rain and snow provide seed for the sower.
Rain and snow provide bread for the eater.
My word comes from My mouth.
My word will not return to Me empty.
My word will do what I desire.
My word will succeed in what I send it to do.
passages.original: כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵרֵד֩ הַגֶּ֨שֶׁם וְהַשֶּׁ֜לֶג מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְשָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב כִּ֚י אִם־ הִרְוָ֣ה אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהוֹלִידָ֖הּ וְהִצְמִיחָ֑הּ וְנָ֤תַן זֶ֙רַע֙ לַזֹּרֵ֔עַ וְלֶ֖חֶם לָאֹכֵֽל׃ כֵּ֣ן יִֽהְיֶ֤ה דְבָרִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִפִּ֔י לֹֽא־ יָשׁ֥וּב אֵלַ֖י רֵיקָ֑ם כִּ֤י אִם־ עָשָׂה֙ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפַ֔צְתִּי וְהִצְלִ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלַחְתִּֽיו׃

passages.text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises deliverance and blessing.
You will go out with joy.
You will be led forward in peace.
The mountains will sing before you.
The hills will also sing before you.
All the trees in the field will clap their hands.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ בְשִׂמְחָ֣ה תֵצֵ֔אוּ וּבְשָׁל֖וֹם תּֽוּבָל֑וּן הֶהָרִ֣ים וְהַגְּבָע֗וֹת יִפְצְח֤וּ לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ רִנָּ֔ה וְכָל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִמְחֲאוּ־ כָֽף׃

passages.text: Instead of the thornbush, a cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, a myrtle will spring up; they will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”
passages.sermon:
God will act.
He will change what is harmful into what is good.
A cypress tree will grow where a thornbush once stood.
A myrtle tree will grow where a brier once grew.
These new trees will honor the LORD.
They will become a sign for the LORD.
This sign will last forever.
No one will destroy it.
passages.original: תַּ֤חַת הַֽנַּעֲצוּץ֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה בְר֔וֹשׁ תַּחַת הַסִּרְפַּ֖ד יַעֲלֶ֣ה הֲדַ֑ס וְהָיָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ לְשֵׁ֔ם לְא֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵֽת׃ס
